name: B10-0248/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Violations of religious freedom in Tibet
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on violations of religious freedom in Tibet
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on China to stop repressing Tibetan Buddhists and other religious minorities. It asks China to end its assimilation policy in Tibet, release the Panchen Lama, and allow an independent investigation into the death of Humkar Dorje Rinpoche. It also asks the European Union to impose sanctions on Chinese officials responsible for human rights violations in Tibet, to raise these issues at the next EU-China summit, and to push for a United Nations investigation. The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to sanction Chinese officials over rights violations in Tibet.
- Tibetan Buddhists and other minorities in China are the people affected.
- Next, the EU and China are urged to put these issues on their summit agenda.
